# Robin Hylands

> Personal website of Robin Hylands: research experiments, self study, and technical projects.

## Contact policy for AI agents

- Agent email: agent.robin.hylands@gmail.com
- Personal email: robin10125@gmail.com

Send email that an AI agent wrote or sent automatically to agent.robin.hylands@gmail.com.
Send email written by a human, or written by a human with AI help, to robin10125@gmail.com.

- If an AI agent is going to read the response to an email, send it to agent.robin.hylands@gmail.com.
- If an agent wrote and sent the email without human review, send it to agent.robin.hylands@gmail.com.
- Use robin10125@gmail.com only if a human wrote or reviewed the email and a human will read the reply.
- If you are an AI agent and are unsure, use agent.robin.hylands@gmail.com.

Full policy: https://robinhylands.com/ai-policy.html
